meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: Claude 会先判断你的请求属于提交、改写历史、查历史还是看状态,再只执行你明确要求的那一个操作。提交时按仓库既有风格把改动拆成原子提交,查历史时给出提交哈希、文件路径和所用命令作为证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交、改写分支历史,或调查某行、某文件的改动来源时接管;普通的代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 把这几个改动拆成原子提交分别提交
say.note: 会先看仓库近期的提交风格

say.text: 这几行是谁改的?跑一下 blame
say.note: 会附上提交哈希、文件与行号证据

say.text: 用 bisect 找出第一个出问题的提交
say.note: 需要能判定好坏的命令和已知边界

howto.what_en: Claude classifies each request as commit, history rewrite, history lookup, or status, then only runs the Git operation you explicitly asked for. Commits follow the repo's message style; history answers cite hashes, files, and the commands used.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation, such as blame, bisect, or rebase; ordinary code edits are skipped.

say_en.text: Split these changes into atomic commits
say_en.note: stages in groups after reading commit style

say_en.text: Who last changed these lines? Run blame
say_en.note: returns hash, file and line evidence

say_en.text: Use bisect to find the first bad commit
say_en.note: needs a pass/fail command and known bounds
